entries.title: Psalms 109:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musicion. A Psalm of David.>> Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

entries.title: Psalms 109:2
segments: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me: They have spoken  unto me with a lying tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 109:3
segments: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.

entries.title: Psalms 109:4
segments: For my love they are my adversaries: But I [give myself unto] prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 109:5
segments: And they have  rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.

entries.title: Psalms 109:6
segments: Set thou a wicked man over him; And let  an adversary stand at his right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 109:7
segments: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty; And let his prayer  be turned into sin.

entries.title: Psalms 109:8
segments: Let his days be few; [And] let another take his office.

entries.title: Psalms 109:9
segments: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

entries.title: Psalms 109:10
segments: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek [their bread]  out of their desolate places.

entries.title: Psalms 109:11
segments: Let the extortioner  catch all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labor.

entries.title: Psalms 109:12
segments: Let there be none to  extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.

entries.title: Psalms 109:13
segments: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

entries.title: Psalms 109:14
segments: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

entries.title: Psalms 109:15
segments: Let them be before Jehovah continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 109:16
segments: Because he remembered not to show kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart, to slay [them].

entries.title: Psalms 109:17
segments: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

entries.title: Psalms 109:18
segments: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.

entries.title: Psalms 109:19
segments: Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

entries.title: Psalms 109:20
segments: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, And of them that speak evil against my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 109:21
segments: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name's sake: Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;

entries.title: Psalms 109:22
segments: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.

entries.title: Psalms 109:23
segments: I am gone like the shadow when it  declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

entries.title: Psalms 109:24
segments: My knees  are weak through fasting; And my flesh faileth of fatness.

entries.title: Psalms 109:25
segments: I am become also a reproach unto them: When they see me, they shake their head.

entries.title: Psalms 109:26
segments: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:

entries.title: Psalms 109:27
segments: That they may know that this is thy hand; [That] thou, Jehovah, hast done it.

entries.title: Psalms 109:28
segments: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, they shall be put to shame, But thy servant shall rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 109:29
segments: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor, And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

entries.title: Psalms 109:30
segments: I will give great thanks unto Jehovah with my mouth; Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

entries.title: Psalms 109:31
segments: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.
